scripts.dev: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run prepare:renderer && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run prepare:renderer && tauri build --no-bundle
scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:workspace && node scripts/prepare-workspace.mjs --require-clean && npm run prepare:renderer && tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.check: npm run prepare:renderer && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.test: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run prepare:renderer && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --locked && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --lib updater::tests && node --test renderer/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run check
